base: Getting startedMochi the cat naps, wanders and fights on the stage while you work. Pick a class to begin; idle claims earn Fish, Yarn, XP and materials.
ClassesWarrior: swordGuardian: hammerRogue: daggersHunter: spearArcher: bowWitch: staffAlchemist: flasks

Chapters and roundsLiving Room: 10 rounds of 6 monsters, boss at the last round.Kitchen: 10 rounds of 10 monsters, boss at the last round.Bathroom: 10 rounds of 10 monsters, boss at the last round.Basement: 10 rounds of 10 monsters, boss at the last round.Night Rooftops: 10 rounds of 10 monsters, boss at the last round.GatedBeing "gated" means the cat needs more power (upgrade gear).

Cat Keys and bossesYou get 1 Cat Key with your first claim each day (hold up to 5). A boss win spends 1 Cat Key. A loss keeps the key and starts a 60 s catnap (one cooldown for all chapters). Rematch cleared bosses for a smaller chest.Daily: 1 Cat Key with your first claim each day.Rare drop: about 1 in 150 monsters in cleared chapters.

ForgeCraft gear with Fish, Yarn and materials (guaranteed rarity per recipe: Common, Uncommon, Rare, Epic, Legendary). Salvage returns part of the cost (always less than it cost). Lock items to protect them in your bag (holds up to 200 items).The Relic: 30 Yarn + 1 Moon Pearl, 1 per day, shared with v1.

Drop ratesFirst-clear chests always give a Moon Pearl (100%), while repeat chests give one with 30% chance. Gear drops average 1.5 items per chest on first clear versus 0.95 items on repeats. Cat Key is absent from chest tables today.For full tables and probabilities, see docs/drop-rates-v2.md.

classic: 1Mochi the cat naps and plays on the strip, earning Fish and Yarn even while you're away (up to 8 h).
2Beat the boss to earn one Cat Key per day (5 fights a day).
3Spend Fish on gear upgrades in Inventory, and equip better drops.
4Forge a Relic with 30 Yarn and 1 Cat Key, and mint it to your wallet on Avalanche Fuji (free testnet, costs no real money).
5Trade your minted Relics with other players in Market.
